**Dear Colleague,**

I had the pleasure of seeing Mark Jordan in consultation today on March 02, 2026. I would like to provide you with a comprehensive update on his medical conditions, which include his history of other cancer, rheumatoid arthritis, and acne.

**Medical History and Current Status**

**Other Cancer (s/p treatment ~11.9 years ago)**

Mr. Jordan was diagnosed with other cancer on October 25, 2013. Fortunately, his cancer has been in a controlled state for approximately 11.9 years. There are no current medications being administered for his cancer treatment.

**Rheumatoid Arthritis**

Mr. Jordan has been managing rheumatoid arthritis since September 04, 2022. His condition is currently controlled, and he is taking hydroxychloroquine 200 mg daily and prednisone 20 mg as prescribed. These medications have effectively managed his symptoms, and he reports no significant side effects. His joint pain and stiffness are minimal, allowing him to maintain a relatively high level of functionality.

**Acne**

Mr. Jordan has had acne since September 26, 2015. His condition is currently controlled with the use of tretinoin 0.05%. He reports that the topical treatment has significantly reduced his acne breakouts and has improved the overall appearance of his skin.

**Physical Examination**

During today's visit, Mr. Jordan's blood pressure was recorded at 138/84 mmHg, and his weight was 175 pounds. His vital signs were otherwise within normal limits. The remainder of his physical examination was unremarkable, with no signs of systemic illness or joint inflammation. His skin showed no active lesions, and there no visible signs of dermatological distress.

**Social History**

Mr. Jordan has a history of tobacco use, having smoked cigarettes at a rate of 1.5 packs per day until he quit on April 13, 2024. He has been honest about his smoking cessation efforts. Additionally, he consumes approximately six alcoholic drinks per week. His alcohol consumption is moderate and does not appear to impact his medical conditions.

**Family History**

Mr. Jordan's father had a myocardial infarction at the age of 72, but the exact age at death is not documented. His father is no longer living.

**Impression and Recommendations**

Mr. Jordan’s overall health status is stable and well-managed. His other cancer remains controlled, and he continues to do well without any additional treatment. His rheumatoid is under good control with his current medication regimen, and he has no significant j

oint pain or swelling. His acne is also well-controlled with topical tretinoin.

It is advisable to continue his current medication regimen without changes unless his clinical condition warrants an adjustment. Regular follow-up visits are recommended to monitor his conditions and to ensure that his treatment plans remain effective.

**Conclusion**

Thank you for referring Mr. Jordan for consultation. I appreciate the opportunity to collaborate on his care. Please do not hesitate to contact me should you need further information or have any concerns.

**Sincerely,**

**Dr. Dana Williams**
